title: Brightwater post-mortem
text:
# Brightwater — what happened (post-mortem)
**Date:** 2026-04-14 · **Attendees:** Karandeep, Bhavin, Dhaval, Pranav

- Agreed settlement with Brightwater last week (letter to be signed). $9,000 credit against future invoices. Mark Delaney "happy to move on".
- Timeline (Pranav): milestone 2 slipped ~3 weeks. Root cause = Brightwater gave us warehouse access 19 days late (their security review). We have the emails showing we asked 4 times.
- Didn't matter. Contract had no exclusion for client-caused delay. Their UK lawyers claimed LD of $18,400 under the delay clause.
- Calloway Stern bill for the back-and-forth: $14,200. Their advice was basically "settle, English courts, you signed it".
- Karandeep: "I signed it at the airport. English law, uncapped LD — I didn't even see it." Contract was with AtliQ Inc.
- Dhaval: he checked scope vs proposal before sending it over, nothing else. "I assumed you'd read the legal bits."
- Bhavin asked whether any other contracts have the same problem. Nobody knew. Karandeep: "I think the rest are ok."
- Pranav: team lost ~2 weeks of senior time to the dispute paperwork.
- Agreed: no more signing on the phone.

*(No other action items were recorded. No review of other signed contracts took place after this meeting.)*

title: Internal contract queue meeting
text:
# Internal — contract queue (ad-hoc, 22 Sep)
Present: Karandeep, Bhavin, Dhaval, Jay

Called because three people chased Karandeep on the same morning.

Queue as of today (from Jay's list on the whiteboard):
- Harrington (Dhaval) — $210k, US, their paper — by **1 Oct**
- Lakeshore (Jay) — $64k, US — by **3 Oct**
- BlueOrchid pilot (Jay) — $38k — by **5 Oct**
- Gulf Crown (Bhavin) — $140k, Saudi — by **10 Oct**
- TravelHub (Karandeep) — $52k, Dubai — no date
- Rheinwerk (Bhavin) — €88k, Munich — draft arriving tomorrow, by **15 Oct**
- Sunrise SOW-2 (Dhaval) — $45k — Meera sending this week, wants by **8 Oct**

Discussion:
- Karandeep: reviewing late at night after calls, 10pm onwards. A client-paper MSA takes him 3–4 hrs properly. "Harrington alone is a whole evening and I haven't started."
- Dhaval raised ShopSwift — SOW sat 9 days in July waiting for review, Elena's budget slipped a quarter. "We lost that one to our own queue."
- Volume: Bhavin reckons last year was ~5 contracts/month, this year ~9 (MSAs, SOWs, NDAs, DPAs, amendments). Only Karandeep signs.
- Went through Gulf Crown headline terms. Midway Karandeep stopped: "didn't we sign something with the Dubai hotel people that stops us doing hotels in the Gulf?"
- Nobody could find the Al Noor contract quickly — Dhaval searched the shared drive, not there. Karandeep thinks it's in his email "somewhere".
- Bhavin: "I think that expired, no? It was a 2025 thing." Karandeep not sure.
- Jay: "is there a list of what we've agreed to not do?" — silence.
- Dhaval asked if we should send Harrington to counsel. Karandeep: "it's $210k, but Mehta Rao takes a week." Not decided.
- Bhavin: Gulf Crown can't slip, Faisal has a summit on the 14th.

Karandeep will go through them this weekend.

*(No owner, order of review, or deadline per contract was agreed. The Al Noor contract was not located during the meeting.)*

title: Call with counsel (Mehta Rao): Gulf Crown / Al Noor
text:
# call w/ Priya Menon (Mehta Rao) — Gulf Crown / Al Noor — 25/9
my notes, rough

- walked her thru Gulf Crown — KSA hotels, rev mgmt + guest analytics
- told her abt Al Noor non-compete (from memory — GCC? 18 months after?). she asked for the actual doc. found it in email after 20 min, sent while on call
- she wants EVERY signed contract w/ restrictive covenants, exclusivity, MFN — "I can't advise on one in isolation"
- me: I don't have a list. would have to open each one
- she: then that's the first job
- also asked: which entity signed Al Noor? and does their affiliate definition catch AtliQ Inc? — didn't know offhand. said I'd check
- asked about Oman waiver — does it help? she said "depends what it says, send it"
- fee: ₹1,20,000 for Gulf Crown + Al Noor review
- turnaround 5–7 working days FROM when she has all docs
- 2 Oct holiday. if I send everything by Thu 1st → 9 Oct best case, 13 Oct worst. Faisal wants signed 10th
- she said don't tell client anything firm till she's read it

TODO: dig out contracts — which ones though??

*(Engagement letter not yet signed as of 2026-09-28. Only the Al Noor agreement was sent to counsel during the call.)*

title: Harrington huddle
text:
# Harrington — quick huddle (Sun 27 Sep, call)
Present: Karandeep, Dhaval, Pranav

- Harrington now = 3 docs: NDA (signed Aug), MSA (their paper, in review), BAA (arrived 16 Sep — Rebecca wants it signed together with the MSA). Dhaval: "one more doc for Harrington."
- Pranav: scoping is going well. Kevin Brooks (their data eng manager) emailed a "sample extract" on 12 Sep so we could size the pipeline. Pranav opened it here and forwarded to Sneha and Vikram in Pune to start profiling. "It's real data I think — names, DOBs, some diagnosis codes."
- Dhaval: the BAA says nobody outside the US touches patient data, so he's bringing in Daniel Ortiz, freelance data engineer in Austin. Contractor agreement + NDA drafted on our US template. "US-based, so the offshore thing is solved."
- Karandeep: "Our cyber policy is $1M btw, Harrington BAA wants 5."
- Pranav asked if the CareBridge setup (the intercompany thing) covers this too — Karandeep: "should do, same kind of work." Nobody checked.
- Dhaval: Rebecca needs MSA + BAA by 1 Oct.

Let's talk Monday.

*(No decisions were made. As of 2026-09-28 no Business Associate Agreement had been signed with Harrington; the sample extract remained with the two Pune engineers; no subcontractor BAA had been drafted for Daniel Ortiz; the insurance gap was not raised with Harrington.)*

title: Novaterra — M4 handover call (17 Oct 2025)
text:
# Novaterra — M4 handover call (17 Oct 2025)
Present: Pranav, Karandeep, (Novaterra) Gareth Holloway, Sam Patel

- M4 accepted on the call. Gareth happy. Final invoice incl. rest of the "framework transfer" fee goes out Monday.
- Gareth asked for the full IngestIQ repo + version history "as per clause 6.5". Pranav to push a copy to their Azure DevOps by Friday.
- After Novaterra dropped off — Pranav: "We've basically sold them IngestIQ for £12k. Fine for this deal, but we use it everywhere." Karandeep: "It was v1.4. We'll just keep building — call the next version something else."
- Pranav: the 140-rule DQ engine is the bit everyone likes. Will "refactor and rebrand" for the next UK client.
- Karandeep: "Make sure nobody sends Novaterra code to another client." Pranav: ok.

title: Zephyr — quarterly partner review (14 Jan 2026, video call)
text:
# Zephyr — quarterly partner review (14 Jan 2026, video call)
Present: Bhavin, Pranav, (Zephyr) Tan Wei Ling, Arvind Rao

- Zephyr: 2 registered opps closed in Q4 — referral fee ~$11k due in Feb.
- Certified engineers: we have 3 (Sneha, Vikram, Aditya). Wei Ling reminded: "minimum is three at all times — if anyone leaves, tell us."
- Wei Ling flagged BFSI: "We hear you're about to sign a bank in Mumbai (Lumen?). Under clause 8 that should have come to us first — it's over 50k." Bhavin: "That one started before we knew it was BFSI-sized, won't happen again."
- Wei Ling: "Please keep the BFSI log we discussed. We'll ask for it at the annual review in June."
- Arvind: Zephyr hearing that Quanta Lake is "signing partners aggressively in India." Asked us to "stay loyal". Bhavin laughed it off.
- Pranav: our renewal is 2028, nothing to worry about yet.

title: Lumen SFB — final acceptance meeting (12 Aug 2026, BKC office)
text:
# Lumen SFB — final acceptance meeting (12 Aug 2026, BKC office)
Present: Dhaval, Pranav, (Lumen) Anand Kulkarni (CRO), Shweta Iyer (Head, Credit Monitoring)

- M4 signed off today — Final Acceptance letter signed by Anand (2 weeks late vs 31 Jul target — delay was their UAT, no LDs).
- Anand very happy: EWS caught 3 MSME accounts going SMA-1 a month early in parallel run.
- Anand, half joking: "Remember, for two years you don't build this for anyone else in India. We paid for the head start."
- Dhaval: "Of course — your model is very Lumen-specific anyway." Pranav (after, in the cab): "The features are 80% generic though. Bureau + repayment behaviour. Any bank would want it."
- Dhaval: "Indus Valley Co-op is going to put out an RFP for EWS, their GM told me at the IBA event. We should be ready."
- Pranav to write a "generic EWS accelerator" deck for sales.

title: Ashwood — weekly check-in (21 Sep 2026, Zoom)
text:
# Ashwood — weekly check-in (21 Sep 2026, Zoom)
Present: Dhaval, (Ashwood) James Coleman (VP Ops), Lisa Tran (Data Manager)

- SOW-2 dashboards stable. Lisa: two communities still entering falls late in the EHR.
- James wants SOW-3 (fall-risk) live before the January state survey season. "Can you throw more people at it? You have that big team in India."
- Dhaval: our US team is 2 people + Daniel (freelancer, shared with Harrington). Could add 4 from Pune.
- Lisa: "Pune can't see PHI, compliance will kill it." James: "Give them a limited data set — no names, no SSNs. That's not really PHI. I'll put it in the SOW."
- Dhaval: "Works for us." Will send our SOW template; James to add the staffing section.
- Dhaval asked whether Monica (Privacy Officer) needs to see it. James: "I'll loop her in later, she's swamped with the audit."

title: Vendor & capacity review (25 Sep 2026, Pune office)
text:
# Vendor & capacity review (25 Sep 2026, Pune office)
Present: Karandeep, Pranav, Dhaval

- Pranav: Q4 overflow is ~900 hrs of pipeline work (Lakeshore, Cobalt if it lands, Cargoline if it lands).
- Pranav wants Monsoon Data Studio (Kochi, 6 people, Anjali — ex-colleague). "Tessellate is slow to staff and their seniors are always on someone else's project."
- Dhaval: how many Tessellate hours have we used? Pranav checked invoices: **~640 hrs** since Nov.
- Karandeep: "Isn't there a minimum on Tessellate? Ravi pushed for something." Pranav: "I think it's a soft target." Nobody had the agreement open.
- Karandeep: OK to start Monsoon on 5 Oct. "Use our standard vendor template." Pranav to draft.
- Karandeep: "And make sure it's fair — remember PixelCraft." Pranav: "It's the template, it should be fine."

title: Pipeline review — "the second queue" (Sat 26 Sep, call)
text:
# Pipeline review — "the second queue" (Sat 26 Sep, call)
Present: Karandeep, Bhavin, Dhaval, Jay, Pranav

Called because the 22 Sep queue didn't include the deals that came in the same fortnight.

Second queue (Jay's list, on top of the 22 Sep one):
- Ashwood SOW-3 (Dhaval) — $67k — by **30 Sep** (James wants to start 1 Oct)
- Cobalt Outfitters (Jay) — $58k, US — by **2 Oct**
- Indus Valley Co-op Bank (Dhaval) — ₹98.5L (~$118k) — by **6 Oct**
- Pillarstone Pharma (Bhavin) — ₹65L (~$78k) — by **9 Oct**
- Corvina SOW-2 (Bhavin) — €74k — start **12 Oct**
- Quanta Lake partnership (Bhavin) — no value, "strategic" — by **12 Oct** (their Q4 launch campaign)
- Aldergrove Water (Bhavin) — £82k, UK — by **14 Oct**
- Cargoline (Bhavin) — ~$92k, Bahrain — "ASAP"
- Greystone Claims (Dhaval) — $86k, US — no date
- Monsoon vendor agreement (Pranav) — ~₹18L — start **5 Oct**

Discussion:
- Jay: Cobalt rate card is $68 senior DE. "Dhaval ok'd on WhatsApp. They have a clause saying they get our best US rate, but we're giving them the best rate, so it's fine."
- Bhavin on Quanta Lake: "This is huge — Middle East launch campaign, MDF money. They want our US company to sign." Pranav: "Don't we have something with Zephyr?" Bhavin: "That's referrals. Different thing."
- Bhavin on Cargoline: "Falconridge restriction is Qatar — Cargoline is Bahrain, so we're fine." Karandeep: "Are you sure?" Bhavin: "Pretty sure."
- Pranav on Aldergrove: IngestIQ makes it 30% cheaper, "that's why we won it".
- Dhaval on Indus Valley: "Same approach as Lumen, fast win." Karandeep: "Is there anything in Lumen about that?" Dhaval: "Their model is theirs, we're building a new one."
- Pillarstone: Bhavin says "pharma distribution, we've done this before — Kestrel." Nobody remembered what Kestrel restricts.
- Greystone: Karandeep: "Didn't we sign something with Halvorsen about claims? Insurance NDA?" Dhaval: "That was early 2025, I think it had some lock-in." Not resolved.
- Corvina: Bhavin "just sending the SOW + a heads-up email about Kriti and SyncRiver".
- Karandeep: "That's 10 more on top of the other 7. I'll start with the ones with dates."
